title: Comment text can't be selected or copied
reason: Reports comment body text inheriting global `user-select: none`, making read-only text impossible to select/copy. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: The affected comments surface is not present in Varve.

title: Dashed and dotted arrows render as solid when zoomed out below 25%
reason: Reports dashed/dotted arrows and geo shapes becoming solid below roughly 25% zoom. The only comment links investigation with #9860 because export shows a related threshold; no fix is confirmed.

varveAssessment.assessment: A valuable low-zoom renderer visual lead; Varve dash behavior was not inspected or compared at the same zoom thresholds.

title: Arrow exports bake in a solid stroke when the canvas is zoomed out
reason: Reports identical dashed-arrow exports changing to solid below the same zoom threshold, while geo shapes remain dashed. The sole reply connects investigation to #9859; no resolution is recorded.

varveAssessment.assessment: Potential separation bug between camera-scaled rendering and export geometry; no Varve reproduction or output comparison was performed.

title: Shifted number-row shortcuts (zoom to fit/selection/100%) break on non-US keyboard layouts
reason: Details shortcuts bound to shifted number-row characters failing or invoking the wrong action on British and German layouts where the produced key differs from US QWERTY. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: A concrete keyboard-layout compatibility lead; Varve shortcut matching was not checked with non-US layouts.

title: Pasting an x.com link creates a text shape instead of a bookmark
reason: Reports X's Copy Link clipboard flavor producing plain text while copying the same URL from the address bar produces a bookmark. This points to source-specific clipboard metadata rather than URL recognition alone. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: A clipboard interoperability candidate; Varve URL paste handling for X clipboard flavors was not inspected or reproduced.

title: Older Firefox versions fail to load tldraw.com (Intl.Segmenter is not a constructor)
reason: Reports blank startup on Firefox versions lacking `Intl.Segmenter` (identified as pre-Firefox 125) without a polyfill or support gate. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Browser support policy and polyfill coverage in Varve were not inspected; do not infer a supported-browser regression from the upstream deployment report.

title: Export image does nothing on an empty file
reason: Reports a silent no-op when exporting an empty hosted file. The sole reply offers to add a toast and fix a missing await, but no merged fix is confirmed.

varveAssessment.assessment: A clear feedback/async-export regression candidate; Varve's empty-document export response was not tested.

title: Track Cloudflare Kitesurf viability for thumbnail and OG rendering
reason: The first reply speculates that Kitesurf may underlie Browser Rendering; a later report says the public React/Vite tldraw app evaluates but never mounts under Kitesurf, yielding a blank screenshot. This is evidence to investigate compatibility, not a migration decision.

varveAssessment.assessment: This concerns a hosted thumbnail browser runtime; no Varve thumbnail service or Kitesurf runtime was evaluated.

title: Expand presence activity beyond pointer movement (keyboard, visibility)
reason: The first comment traces presence timestamps through InputsManager and notes keyboard dispatch does not update them, while collaborators can be marked idle/hidden during keyboard edits. It proposes throttled presence writes while preserving zero as fresh-join; the second reply calls it a good catch. This is a detailed upstream collaboration report.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's collaboration/presence pipeline is a stub and has no equivalent idle-peer service to fix.

title: Make new file creation feel instant when signed in on tldraw.com
reason: Research corrects the initial claim: creation/navigation is already optimistic and local-first; the delay is blank-canvas editor mounting plus a new-file propagation race in the hosted DO lookup, with broader findings in #9926 and related proposals #9927/#9928. The final reply supports continued performance work.

varveAssessment.assessment: The detailed latency chain uses upstream Zero, Durable Objects, Postgres, Clerk, and R2; Varve's local-first file creation path differs and was not benchmarked here.
